gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-yi: Flavors is playful and bossy at once, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a lowercase that towers. Noto Sans Yi follows with deep-bodied lowercase and open, unlatched rounds that keep a long page of text moving.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-traditional: Almendra Display brings an ornate, bookish voice, its tall lowercase never pinching shut. And Noto Traditional Nushu does the quieter work, with broad pen-like strokes and full bowls that make a sans-serif body approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep even tiny sizes crisp. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square against Audiowide's tile-like, single-weight techy letters is the pair's boldest quality: futuristic up top, approachable below.
gen-eater-gf-numans: Aggressive and dark, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its thin strokes surprisingly sturdy beside moderate stems. Numans on a plain sans footing runs modern and clean, its generous tracking letting paragraphs unspool easily.
gen-flavors-gf-onest: Onest has short ascenders over big bowls and a gentle monotone line, a friendly, contemporary sans. Onest gives Flavors, whimsical and towering in the lowercase, a steady partner that lets the heading's personality stand out.
gen-almendra-display-gf-orienta: Orienta reads modern and neutral, its counters breathing open and its upper and lowercase sitting close in height, like a plain sans. Beneath Almendra Display, paragraphs feel unhurried and easy to settle into.
gen-audiowide-gf-open-sans: Open Sans reads smoothly, with bulky lowercase and no clogged curves. Audiowide excels at futuristic, tile-spaced headings in one flat line weight, while Open Sans is built for sustained, contemporary sans-serif text.
gen-eater-gf-oxygen: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders. Oxygen carries a long page smoothly, its open curves and near-capital lowercase making a clean sans feel contemporary and unforced.
gen-flavors-gf-parkinsans: Chunky and cheeky, Flavors towers in the lowercase with diagonals as heavy as its stems. And Parkinsans, a plain sans with one stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters, stays crisp and modern over a long paragraph.
gen-almendra-display-gf-pt-sans-caption: Literary, with letters that never pinch shut, Almendra Display leads with ornate character and a pronounced x-height. PT Sans Caption does the practical work instead, its big-bodied lowercase and inviting bowls keeping a sans line professional and readable.
